problem: The frozen retriever often finds the right document, but its fixed head preview can omit the exact answer field and pi-browsecomp-v10 cannot reopen BM25 anchors around the unresolved answer obligation.
simplest_baseline: Pi v10 with the same frozen DeepSeek Flash model, BM25-five plus Dense-fifteen retriever, eight-search cap, evidence-ingress limits, 10,000 output tokens, and head-only previews.
hypothesis: On 25 previously unused development questions, letting the agent open one deterministic 512-token window from any already disclosed document using a typed answer obligation will gain at least one net Qwen-Judge-correct answer without losing normalized exact match or exceeding matched resource gates.
changed_mechanisms: answer-obligation-conditioned span opening for previously disclosed anchors and leads
anti_claim: Any difference is a harness evidence-disclosure effect under a frozen API model, not a model capability improvement, official BrowseComp score, or general superiority claim.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Delegating the same truncated evidence cannot recover a field hidden outside the exposed span; the smaller intervention is a constrained evidence-opening contract.
Generic compression is downstream of the observed loss; the answer-bearing span must be exposed before synthesis or compression can preserve it.
More crawler breadth adds cost when the relevant source is already in the ledger but its requested field is outside the fixed preview.
The current calibrated failure is evidence truncation inside retrieved documents, not repeated omission of independent research branches.

frozen_controls: deepseek-v4-flash with high thinking and empty system prompt
BM25 five anchors plus Qwen dense fifteen leads
eight search calls and eight evidence-open calls maximum
33,280 total evidence-ingress tokens and 4,096 open-evidence tokens
next_action: Freeze new span-opening variants and run a zero-provider bad-case audit over the three paired improvements, two paired regressions, and all 13 successful-open cases. Separate open-versus-search substitution, wrong-document opening, answer-bearing-span availability, and synthesis loss before proposing one new mechanism.
claim_boundary: The preregistered fresh-development gate rejected v14. The persistent diagnostic Judge moved from 11/25 to 12/25 with three paired improvements and two regressions, but normalized exact fell from 7/25 to 6/25, evidence recall fell from 59.17% to 55.83%, and baseline schema completeness was 24/25. Candidate search calls fell from 180 to 158 while it attempted 44 opens, so the next causal question is whether opening displaced useful breadth. Recorded provider cost was $0.34271815 across both arms; one failed post-provider trace-validation attempt has unobservable cost, so this is a lower bound. These are development harness results, not official accuracy, leaderboard standing, general framework superiority, or model-capability improvement.
